description: Check whether an EU VAT number is registered in the European Commission's VIES system and return the company name and address when the member state discloses them. Use it to verify a business customer before invoicing. VIES is sometimes unavailable; that returns an error, not 'invalid'. Use validate_tax_id for Latin American or Spanish ID format checks. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: POST /vat/validate via x402.

countryCode.description: EU country code of the VAT number, e.g. DE, IE, ES (use EL for Greece).

vatNumber.description: VAT number without the country prefix, e.g. 6388047V.

name: vat_validate
title: Validate an EU VAT number (VIES)
